title: Range Slider last pip not aligned to the right of the slider
body:
Issue opened on the wrong repository (instantsearch/instantsearch-ion.rangeSlider#1)
Browser is Chrome 46.0.2490.86 (64-bit)

I'll push a PR to fix according to the discussion we've had there

***

I'm not sure whether this is due to the default styling or to the column the slider is contained in...
No external styles seem to be applied to the widget.

Here 5000$ is the maximum value but the slider goes a few pixels out to the right:

![capture d ecran 2015-11-30 18 07 07](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/314079/11478421/3440877a-978d-11e5-9b06-c890c0f1acb5.png)

By commenting `width: 100%` in the `.ais-range-slider--base` rules, I get a correct display:

![capture d ecran 2015-11-30 18 10 34](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/314079/11478505/ac52b6ca-978d-11e5-8f8d-40dad6c46f42.png)

In none of both cases does the slider actually take up 100% of its container...
